messages:
Maya Chen: Quick async milestone check — callout for kernel-prefetch + continuous-batching. What blockers do we have before the wide canary?
Jonah Patel: canary failing on long sequences in region eu-west-1. repro log attached.
Jonah Patel: `runtime: kv_miss ratio spikes when seq_len > 1024`, looks like our kv-eviction heuristic is thrashing.
Li Wei: I'm on the kv eviction heuristic PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4021). Still need to add a guard for hot-prefix eviction, doing perf runs now.
Maya Chen: thx Li. Who owns the canary gating checklist? we need the infra flag to force fallback to small-batch kernel if kv thrash observed.
Ryan Gomez: I can add the flag in eng-platform (alpha switch). Pinged infra-tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-889. ETA EOD.
Jonah Patel: @Ryan will need the kernel tag to wire into the routing policy. PR for routing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1782 (needs review).
Li Wei: ack. small note: in local repro the kv eviction threshold is computed from sequence window size, but continuous-batching changes the distribution so threshold must be dynamic. I'm prototyping a lightweight percentile-based threshold.
Maya Chen: good. Can you leave a short explainer in the PR description so reviewers understand the tradeoff?
Li Wei: done. added a short note + perf plot.
Jonah Patel: still failing in canary because batch sizes spike under burst traffic. Is there a temp mitigation we can land quickly?
Maya Chen: two options: (1) fall back to microbatch kernel for requests > 1024 tokens (quick config), (2) throttle request batching at the router for canary region. Which is faster?
Ryan Gomez: (1) is faster to roll; I can add a routing override to prefer microbatch kernel when seq_len >= 1024. I'll coordinate with deployment.
Jonah Patel: I'll open a tiny PR to add the kernel-override hook, requesting quick review from @Maya and @Li.
Maya Chen: ping reviewers: @Li Wei please eyeball the heuristic change, @Jonah I'll review the router hook.
Li Wei: will review tonight. if tests pass I'll approve tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: deployment event: canary/deploy/2026-03-17-18:12 started (region eu-west-1)
Jonah Patel: logging note: add a short metric `kv_eviction_recoveries` so we can track if fallback reduces thrash. small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics/pull/910
Maya Chen: yep add the metric + a dashboard widget under Runtime -> Canary KPIs. I'll add it to the console.
Ryan Gomez: infra update: ENGPLAT-889 created, will attach Terraform change and a rollout plan. tagging infra owners @ops-team.
Maya Chen: ownership summary for this thread:
- Kernel eviction heuristic: Li Wei (PR 4021)
- Router override for microbatch: Jonah Patel (new PR)
- Infra flag / rollout: Ryan Gomez (ENGPLAT-889)
- Canary monitoring/dashboard: Maya Chen
If anyone disagrees, call it out now.
Li Wei: LGTM.
Jonah Patel: LGTM, will open PR and request urgent reviews.
Maya Chen: timeline: aim to land router override + infra flag by tomorrow noon UTC, then rerun canary. If we still see kv thrash, we'll gate canary.
Ryan Gomez: copying deployment steps here for quick runbook:
```
# quick rollback / fallback
1. set engplat.flag.kernel_microbatch_override = true
2. `service rollout restart --region eu-west-1 --canary` (ops CLI)
3. watch metrics: kv_eviction_recoveries, median_latency_99
```
Jonah Patel: noted. I'll also add a smoke test that sends 3 long-seq requests in 30s to trigger the path.
Maya Chen: thanks all. I'll follow up in the morning with the dashboard panel link. please drop short updates here after PRs land. :thumbsup:
